audience: field-service companies that dispatch technicians and bill jobs in FieldEdge

useCases.title: Find open work orders that have no technician
useCases.text: List the work orders that have no technician assigned yet. Open one to see its service address, task and tags.

useCases.title: Look up a customer by phone and read the notes
useCases.text: Find a customer by phone number. Then read the notes and file attachments on the record before you call back.

useCases.title: Check the invoice and quote of a job
useCases.text: Open an invoice or a quote to read its line items. Both use the id of their work order, so you can match them to the job.

useCases.title: Add a new customer with a note about the job
useCases.text: Search for the customer first to avoid a duplicate. Then create the customer and add a note with the job details.

useCases.title: Create a work order for a customer location
useCases.text: Look up the business unit, lead source and task. Then create the work order for the customer location.

useCases.title: Schedule a technician and update the visit status
useCases.text: Assign a technician to a work order. List the assignments to find its id, then set the status, such as working or completed.
